description: Type text into an input or textarea element. Uses React-compatible value setting (native setter + input/change events). Auto-waits up to 5 seconds for the element. Use browser_fill as an alias.

selector.description: CSS selector for the input element. Inside an iframe (cross-origin too): 'iframe#card >>> input[name=cardnumber]'

text.description: Text value to type into the element

name: browser_type
